news.title: Full year 2026 earnings: EPS and revenues exceed analyst expectations
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹43.53 (up from ₹27.40 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹97.8b (up 28% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹4.92b (up 59% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 5.0% (up from 4.1% in FY 2025). The increase in margin was driven by higher revenue. Revenue exceeded analyst estimates by 3.2%. Earnings per share (EPS) also surpassed analyst estimates by 5.4%. Revenue is forecast to grow 15% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 20% growth forecast for the Electrical industry in India.

news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹10.46 (up from ₹6.07 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹25.5b (up 43% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹1.18b (up 72% from 3Q 2025). Revenue is forecast to grow 15% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 20% growth forecast for the Electrical industry in India.
